bio: Two friends run this chic, minimalist restaurant in a stylishly understated way. Available in a longer or shorter form, their tasting menu comprises creative, well-balanced dishes with a strong focus on seasonal produce and Czech ingredients. Don't be surprised to see a sauce being flambéed tableside or smoke rising from a box (containing a delicious brioche glazed with duck fat)! The excellent medium-rare fallow deer also deserves a mention, as well as ‘Lamb, kale, watercress, green tea’. The friendly and attentive front-of-house team, which includes a sommelier, will be happy to recommend and explain apt wine pairings. The two different versions of the shorter lunchtime set menu are served on weekdays and at the weekend, respectively....
